provenance.method: Bounded review of NHS England's current accessible information about the Reasonable Adjustment Digital Flag; England scope preserved.

name: NHS England Reasonable Adjustment Digital Flag information
description: NHS England accessible information about the Reasonable Adjustment Digital Flag used to record and share reasonable-adjustment needs in relevant NHS services.
intended_use: Understanding an England-specific mechanism that may help services know about recorded adjustment needs.
audience_or_context: People using NHS services in England; this mechanism must not be presented as a four-nation UK system.
limitations: England-specific implementation; Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland have their own systems and service arrangements.
A flag does not guarantee that every requested adjustment will be available or clinically appropriate.
